about.en:
Future We Want Model United Nations (FWWMUN) runs international Model UN conferences in cities on five continents. FWWMUN Nairobi takes place on 24–27 June 2027 in a partner 4- or 5-star hotel (venue to be confirmed). It opens with workshops on youth involvement, the Sustainable Development Goals and leadership, followed by committee sessions run under the FWWMUN rules of procedure.

High-school and university students can register as individuals or as a delegation (at least five delegates; high-school delegations need a faculty advisor). Country assignments are released in rounds, and position papers are due a few weeks before the conference. Nairobi hosts UNEP and UN-Habitat, the only UN headquarters in the Global South.

It suits students who want an international, multi-day MUN experience abroad with participants from many countries; registration is first come, first served and visa invitation letters are issued after payment.

about.en:
LUMS Model United Nations (LUMUN) is a student-run conference at the Lahore University of Management Sciences that has brought together school, college and university delegates from across Pakistan for more than twenty years. LUMUN XXIII takes place on 4–7 January 2027 at LUMS, Lahore, with a programme of general, specialised and crisis committees chaired by experienced student officers.

Delegates can register as a delegation of 2–10 students from a school, college or university, or as private (individual) delegates; international delegates have their own fee band, and accommodation and socials can be booked during registration. Mandatory liability and code-of-conduct documents must be acknowledged before paying.

It is a large, competitive four-day conference and a strong choice for students in South Asia who want serious debate and a well-known name on their CV.

about.en:
LUIMUN 2026 is organised by the Leading University Model United Nations Association (LUMUNA), founded in 2016, and marks its fifth international edition. It runs over four days, 23–26 December 2026, in Sylhet in north-east Bangladesh under the theme 'A World in Transition: Reimagining Global Cooperation, Advancing Human Progress, and Shaping Our Shared Future'.

Ten committees include the UN Security Council and the International Court of Justice, and the conference expects more than 400 delegates. It is open to school and university students from Bangladesh and abroad.

A good-value, four-day international conference for South Asian students looking to build MUN experience.

The United Diplomats Global Assembly (UDGA) 2027 takes place on 25–29 January 2027 at the United Nations Conference Centre (UNCC) in Bangkok. Around 280 delegates simulate the UN General Assembly on one agenda — safe and ethical AI, AI-driven disinformation and the digital divide — and also take part in networking, a city tour and leadership sessions.

Young people can apply as individuals or as delegations. Packages range from conference-only to full experience with twin-share hotel and transfers, and a scholarship track (with a small application fee) covers 50–100% of costs.

A rare chance to debate inside a UN venue; worth considering mainly through the scholarship track because full packages are expensive.

about.en:
AUBMUNC is the official Model United Nations conference of the American University of Beirut and has run for nearly ten years. The 2027 edition (its 10th) combines pre-conference training and preparation resources, an on-campus mock conference, and the final conference on Saturday–Sunday 10–11 April 2027 in West Hall, AUB.

Schools register delegations through an advisor, and students can also register as independent delegates. No prior MUN experience is required; committees cover political, humanitarian, economic, legal and environmental topics, all in English. Outstanding delegates may be recognised with awards and, subject to availability, scholarships and internship opportunities offered through AUBMUNC partners.

A strong choice for school students in Lebanon and the region who want a university-level conference on one of the Middle East's best-known campuses.
